pythonEvidence.note: The focused run repeats 17 existing cases and adds one trace-alert stream regression. Encoding assertions were added to an existing HTTP case and rerun separately.

browserChecks: Bootstrap through the browser creates an authenticated organization
Session token is absent from browser storage and cookies
Real two-tab stale update is rejected and draft retained
Explicit conflict resolution and independent field merge persist
Invalid JSON leaves the saved record unchanged
Pagination reads bounded pages and stored markup renders as text
Telemetry ingestion and search run through the real browser and SQLite
Desktop and narrow layouts render without horizontal overflow
Revision-protected browser delete removes the persisted dashboard
Logout and reload clear the in-memory browser session
packaging: Build distributable wheel with pinned build dependencies
Wheel contains current application and browser assets without database or environment files
Install wheel into a separate directory without an editable source checkout
Installed application imports from wheel, serves assets and persists authenticated CRUD
limitations: Local single-node SQLite application; no public deployment or distributed scheduler.
Dashboard configuration editor, not a rendered chart engine; OTLP aliases use custom envelopes.
JSON merges operate per field; CRUD creates have no general operation receipts.
Webhook tests use fake senders and mocked DNS, with no live provider delivery.
Migration verified on synthetic historical schemas; legacy naive timestamps are interpreted as UTC.
Direct dependency versions pinned; no complete operating-system or transitive dependency lock.
